cohort: The study included neonates with moderate/severe hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) who received therapeutic hypothermia (TH).
finding: High post-rewarming procalcitonin levels in neonates with HIE/TH were significantly associated with severe HIE and cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The risk of a high procalcitonin level was found to be 5.2-fold higher in neonates born via cesarean delivery.
cross-section timing: After rewarming was completed following therapeutic hypothermia.
